header.title: German export rebound on US and EU trade recovery and competitiveness gains

s01_bottom_line.text: Goldman Sachs Research forecasts robust German real-export growth of 3.5% in 2026 and 2.4% in 2027, driven by recovering US trade, an EU trade tailwind since early 2025, and productivity-driven competitiveness gains. ⟨cited figures: forecast⟩
The article concludes that positive near-term indicators, competitiveness gains, stronger US/EU demand and AI spillovers point to healthy export growth ahead.
A broad German export recovery is positive for German manufacturing and the German economy, but the article frames it at a macro/sector level rather than naming investable securities.
